text:
Alyssa: HaloEdge mini-EAP onboarding. Partner sent an agent (halo-edge-agent v1.0-alpha) that streams per-core power + thermal zones. NDA in place but they require an attestation token to enable the agent. Who can own the attestation flow?
James: I can coordinate. We need to confirm KMS access pattern and token TTL. Also want a brief spec: what fields the agent emits.
Priya: Can run the quantized model bench once image is ready. Which model variant are we validating? Llama-2-7B-ptq or 13B-ptq? My vote is 7B for quick turn.
Mike P: 7B sounds good for initial pass. Note: agent needs a kernel helper (halo-helper v0.4) that requires sudo to install. That may block our dedicated auto workers.
Alyssa: Partner said they can provide an agent mode that writes CSV to /tmp/export.csv if we can't install helper. Ask them for that as fallback.
James: Got it. Partner confirmed CSV fallback and gave schema (fields: timestamp, core_id, power_w, temp_c, freq_mhz). Uploaded to the partnership folder: https://dropbox.redwood/haloedge/agent-schema-v1.json
Priya: Perf harness command (initial):
```
python run_perf.py --model l2-7b-ptq --seq 256 --batch 4 \
  --telemetry ./halo-edge-agent --telemetry-mode stream \
  --workload conv_promptset_v1.json --collect joules_per_token
```
CI-bot: job queued: haloedge-mini-eap-run-1741234567-1 -> dedicated-pool-3, ETA 22m :hourglass: 
Mike P: Filing infra ticket for sudo install on dedicated nodes. If infra denies, we'll use CSV fallback. Ticket: INFRA-4821.
Elaissa (Legal): I think you mean Elaine. :slightly_smiling_face: Clarification from legal: embargo window must be agreed with partner. Also need retention window for telemetry (partner wants 90 days). We typically allow 30-90 days depending on risk. Send me proposed retention and any identifiers in payload.
Alyssa: Thanks Elaine. We should propose 60 days and redact any customer-identifying fields. James, please send the schema and samples to Elaine.
James: Done. Dropped sample export from partner into shared folder and pinged Elaine. https://internal.redwood/files/haloedge/samples/first-run.csv
Priya: If we get the streamed agent we can measure p50/p95/p99 latency and energy/token with 10 warmup tokens and 50 measured tokens. I'll try both balanced and conserve power_mode.
Mike P: Note: partner agent supports a device-level `throttle_hint` that simulates thermal headroom. We should document experiment matrix: performance|balanced|conserve x throttle_hint 0.0/0.5/1.0.
Alyssa: Good call. Owners: James (partner comms & attestation), Priya (bench + metrics), Mike (infra & install), Elaine (legal). Aim: sandbox runs this week, summary to partner and draft co-auth blog (if both agree) next Tues.
James: Partner requested a short co-auth outline. I'll draft a skeleton and attach to the shared drive. Elaine: will you need to review before we share?
Elaine (Legal): Yes, review before any partner-facing draft. Also confirm that any quoted numbers are reproducible and we include measurement methodology.
Priya: Quick blocker: our perf harness doesn't yet ingest the agent stream format. I'll add a converter to parse the JSON stream into joules/token. ETA EOD.
CI-bot: attach: run log will appear in https://ci.internal.redwood/runs/1741234567 when job finishes.
Alyssa: If infra blocks kernel helper permanently, plan B: use CSV telemetry + degrade resolution note in runbook. I'll update runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/haloedge-mini-eap. Ping here with any blockers. :rocket:
